newsitem.title: GREECE: Agricultural Bank to tender Bank of Central Greece.
newsitem.headline: Agricultural Bank to tender Bank of Central Greece.

text.p: State Agricultural Bank will announce details of its tender to sell its stake in Bank of Central Greece by Thursday next week, sources said.
Agricultural Bank wants to sell between 51 to 56.6 percent of subsidiary Central Bank of Greece and 20.1 percent of its preferred shares it holds.
It has retained ABN AMRO and Deloitte & Touche as advisors on the sale.

The Bank of Central Greece was founded in 1936 and was listed on the Athens stock exchange in 1991. It has a network of 22 branches and employs 580. Total deposits in year-end 1996 were 117.5 billion drachmas and total loans were 67 billion.
